verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's manifesto commits to being "Backwards-compatible - so that the existing code can drive value for years to come," which is a first-party compatibility promise, though only at a high level. The "drop-in replacement for Terraform" claim and the community reports of easy migration cover Terraform-to-OpenTofu compatibility, not compatibility between OpenTofu releases, so they get no credit here. missing for 10: per-release upgrade/migration guides, a formal versioning or compatibility policy (e.g. semver guarantees, deprecation schedule), changelog documentation of breaking changes, and independent corroboration of upgrade experiences between OpenTofu versions.
